main_measure.name: mean excess return close t+1 to close t+3 after top-decile positive forecasts
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; fewer than 30 non-overlapping cases is not observable

supporting_check.name: mean 3-bar excess return close t to t+3 vs coin mean 3-bar return, > 0

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Top decile = positive forecasts at or above the pooled 90th percentile of positive forecasts; the coin's mean 2-bar (and 3-bar) return is taken over every bar of all its windows pooled, each return inside one window; cases on the same coin and window whose bars are at most 3 apart are chained into one case whose value is the mean of its members' excess returns; t is the ordinary t of the mean.
